reviews.title: Overall, Not Bad
reviews.comment: Overall, Not Bad. My honest score would be more 4.5/5 stars but overall I am satisfied with the product. All the fans (120, 240 & 360R) all work perfectly fine. No issues. Everything you need comes in the box. Installation is simple like any other fan. CPU & GPU idle temps were around 47-55C consistently. Only issue I personally had is the only way to control the RGB lighting effect are from a small black control. You click the button and it will cycle through preset colors & styles but none are customizable. Couldn’t get Signal, Gigabyte RGB control, Lian Li, etc. to customize the fans personally. Just something to be aware of but they work great.
reviews.author: Sean Eubanks

reviews.title: New favorite fan
reviews.comment: Absolutely gorgeous. If you want a clean 1 piece looked for your fans these are one of the few options available. Lighting looks great. Installation is much easier dont have to easier chain a bunch of individual fans together and try and hide all the wires.
